recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的細胞質內有多條交錯成束的 Auer rods（faggot cell），周圍是細胞質充滿顆粒、核呈折疊或雙葉狀的異常前骨髓細胞，典型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）表現。
features: Abnormal promyelocyte (arrow) with bundles of multiple crisscrossing Auer rods (faggot cell)
Surrounding large cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules obscuring nuclear borders
Nuclei folded, reniform, or bilobed with fine chromatin
Monotonous population of abnormal promyelocytes without normal maturation in field
describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a monotonous population of abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules and folded to bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin. One cell (arrow) contains bundles of numerous crisscrossing Auer rods, a so-called faggot cell. Normal maturing granulocytic elements are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA; urgent coagulation studies and molecular confirmation are recommended.

ddx.vs: AML with t(8;21) typically shows single long slender Auer rods and salmon-colored granules with maturation, not bundles of Auer rods in hypergranular promyelocytes.

ddx.dx: Reactive left shift with increased promyelocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with a Golgi hof and orderly maturation, and never contain Auer rods.
The PLZF variant shows more regular nuclei and pseudo-Pelger cells with fewer faggot cells and is ATRA-resistant, requiring molecular testing to separate.
